notes: A new layout, not another coat of paint. The window splits at the golden ratio: your skills on the left, and a rail of four cards on the right for Status, Play, Character and Tools, so the thing you press lives with the things it affects. Every colour pair is now measured against the readability standard and the build fails if any text is illegible, which fixed white text on the green START and on the cyan buttons. Disabled buttons grey out properly instead of looking pressable, the keys show as gold keycaps, and the status line became pills with a dot.
